sentences.en: One step further, and you will fall into an abyss.
sentences.zh: 再走一步，你就会掉进深渊。

sentences.en: A single step, and you will fall over the cliff.
sentences.zh: 迈一步，你就可能从悬崖上摔下来。

sentences.en: Another step, and you would have fallen down the stairs.
sentences.zh: 再迈一步，你就会从楼梯上摔下去。

senses.zh: 脚步，步 - 一步的距离，短距离 - 楼梯，台阶 - 级别，等级；阶段 - 步骤，措施 -
